name: Two letters find the app, the field completes its name, and Return opens it

media.caption: Two typed letters find the app, the field completes its name, and Return opens it.
media.alt: A recording of Slick's search panel in dark mode over a purple gradient wallpaper. The panel shows three suggested apps. Typing “d” lists results and completes the field to “drift Browser”, with the rest of the name in grey. Typing “r” narrows the list to Drift Browser, Search Docs.rs, Eject All Disks, Cadence Calendar and three commands. Return opens Drift Browser and the panel closes. Recorded from the assembled app running a scripted scenario, over made-up sample apps whose icons are plain colored squares.
media.posterAlt: Slick's search panel in dark mode with “dr” typed and the rest of “Drift Browser” in grey after the cursor. Drift Browser is selected above six more results. A frame from a recording of the assembled app over made-up sample apps.
